text:
Sam: Heads-up — OpalCorp private VPC deploy scheduled Wed 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC. Need clear deploy owner, smoke checklist, and rollback plan. Who's taking lead?

Ravi: I can own the deploy. Plan: handoff at 02:30 UTC, start cutover 03:00. I'll be on the bridge and pager.

Jia: I can run smoke tests during the window. Can we lock success criteria + a quick runbook?

Louise: Rollback readiness: we've got a nightly AMI snapshot from 00:00 UTC and DB replica sync. Full rollback playbook is at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/opal-vpc (note: read-only).

Kevin: I'll handle LB switch and the maintenance page. Will add the maintenance DNS TTL lower at 02:45.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "OpalCorp VPC Deploy" Wed 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC — invite sent to participants. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Quick question — any DB schema migrations in this release?

Jia: No blocking migrations. All schema work is backward compatible; feature-flag toggle for new behavior. We should still run read/write smoke tests against the new app + replica.

Ravi: For visibility, here's the minimal checklist I'm expecting:

```
- pre-checks (02:10): disk space, node health, KV cache warm
- freeze external traffic (02:50): route to staging edge
- deploy binary (03:00)
- run smoke tests (03:05)
- cut LB to new instances (03:15)
- post-checks (03:20): errors, 95p latency, token costs
- rollback window until 03:45
```

Jia: Smoke test commands I'll run: 

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://opal.internal/api/v1/login | jq .status
curl -s https://opal.internal/api/v1/embeddings -d '{"text":"hello"}' | jq .embedding_length
ab -n 100 -c 10 https://opal.internal/api/v1/generate
```

Louise: Also mute noisy alerts for this window: `opsctl alerts mute --team=eng-platform --reason="opal deploy" --duration=90m`. I'll create a temporary pager routing rule to me + Ravi.

Kevin: Rolling back will be: revert LB + trigger rollback job which reverts ASG to previous AMI. Ravi, can you confirm rollback command is ready?

Ravi: Confirmed. Rollback shortcut: `./deploy_tools/rollback.sh --env=opal-prod --timeout=20m`. I've added the SG snapshot ID to the playbook.

Sam: I'm pasting a short runbook snippet for the bridge in case someone joins late:

```
Bridge join: zoom.us/j/111111111
Owner: Ravi
Pre-deploy: check shard sync, memcache hit rate > 85%
Smoke tests: run Jia's scripts, check 5xx rate < 0.1% for 5 minutes
Rollback: run rollback.sh, revert LB, then escalate to infra if DB lag > 30s
Post-deploy: add release note + unmute alerts
```

Jia: I'll post smoke test results in this thread. If anything fails, I will call rollback and tag @Ravi.

Louise: Ops checklist updated in the runbook. I've also taken a backup of the customer config and stored it to s3://backups/opal/2026-03-25-00.

Kevin: Lowering DNS TTL to 60s at 02:45 UTC, will restore to 300s at 04:00.

Sam: Please reply with an ack once you've added your steps to the runbook and are happy with the rollback. Trying to keep this fully async unless we need the bridge.

Ravi: ACK — runbook looks good, rollback ready. I'll be on the bridge. :rocket:

Jia: ACK — smoke scripts uploaded and scheduled.

Louise: ACK — alerts muted and backups taken.

Kevin: ACK — DNS + LB plan set.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled 15m before deploy.

Sam: Great, thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread open for any last-minute questions.

Kevin: One more note — customer contact On-call is set to Opal CSM (marta@opal.com). Ravi, please include them on the post-deploy status.

Sam: Will do. End of thread.
